anomalies.description: A dark vehicle ahead loses control on the icy road, slides sideways across the lane, and collides with the right guardrail, kicking up snow and debris.
A white sedan overtakes on the left and collides with the dashcam vehicle, causing a visible impact and spray of debris/snow; the white car spins sharply right after contact.

A truck on the right side of the road loses control on the icy surface, veers off the roadway, and crashes into the snowbank, kicking up a large plume of snow and debris. The vehicle appears to roll or jackknife upon impact.; A severe multi-vehicle collision on a snowy road involving at least two trucks; one truck is overturned on the right shoulder with visible damage and debris, while another truck (with 'Красное & Белое' branding) is stopped adjacent to it, showing front-end damage. Snow and dust are being kicked up, indicating recent impact.; A separate incident: a motorcycle (or similar two-wheeled vehicle) appears to lose control or crash on a wet road in summer conditions, as evidenced by the sudden appearance of a dark object (likely rider or bike) entering the frame from the right and impacting the road surface near the guardrail.

A silver SUV (appears to be a BMW X5) suddenly swerves left from the right lane into the path of the recording vehicle, causing a near-collision or minor impact; the SUV is seen crossing the centerline and then correcting sharply back to the right lane while the recording vehicle continues forward.
